theme: Clear the decks before Saturday's charter.
greeting: An open day in Dubrovnik, Dan, with the girls at Jen's. Saturday you board the Nautilus charter and signal goes dark, so today is the day to tie off the transfers, the car, and the St Pete gap while you still can.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the charter boarding and return
needsAttention.detail: You board Saturday and connectivity drops to nothing on the water. Confirm the exact boarding time and location, and arrange the airport transfer for disembarkation on the 19th, while you're still ashore.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat hotel: transfers, bag hold, checkout
needsAttention.detail: All three need sorting from dry land before you sail: the noon transfer Komolac to Cavtat on the 19th, an early-afternoon bag hold, and the ~5:15 AM checkout for LH4297. The hotel is free-cancel only until Sept 15.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 20 to Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge, since the Pathfinder can't reach Florida before Oct 18. Full-size SUV at TPA, Sept 20 to Oct 5, so you don't land jet-lagged on a Sunday to walk-up rates.

needsAttention.title: Close the St Pete lodging gap
needsAttention.detail: Two nights still open Sept 20 to 22 before the Orlando villa. Also glance at whether the Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

flagged.title: Valoris / Nomura call still owed
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano wants to schedule the call and floated proposing a real project for Nomura; your reply has been sitting since last week.

inbox.noise: Everything else is travel confirmations and receipts: Airbnb, Chase, PayPal, a baggage receipt.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: The first real week of autumn calls for kabocha and chestnuts — a slow, technique-driven plate for a cooling evening.

tasks.title: Sort Disney tickets for the Sept 26 to 27 weekend

acts.line: An open start in Dubrovnik, with the Old Port and a slow coffee before anything else.
The last reliable stretch of signal before the boat, worth spending on whatever needs the internet.
A calm last night ashore before Saturday's boarding.
